coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: P9

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- computed from real DataSF street/curb data plus the owner's own marked stopping line (not a surveyed parcel or GIS file from the project team). The north/west edges are exact real street-buffer boundary. The south edge is the owner's own line, not a mapped street or parcel boundary -- there is real bare ground between it and the two buildings further south that isn't included here, since the owner indicated the parcel doesn't extend that far. The P9/P7 split is a straight line, not sourced to any drawn plan boundary. No named, funded project (e.g. an SF Rec & Park schematic, unlike P2) has been found specifically naming P9.
notes.digitized_from: Computed from DataSF's official street centerline/curb data (src/street_geometry.py's build_street_buffer(), plus an extra generous buffer around Owens St's own centerline and around the P10 roundabout island) rather than hand-traced pixels. The west/north edge is the real Mission Bay Dr street-buffer boundary; the south edge is the owner's own drawn line (extracted from their annotated screenshot via the same ORB/homography technique used for P11/P11A, re-applied here to a grid-calibrated render of this project's own map rather than a satellite photo) confirming the true stopping point is well short of the two real buildings further south, not at their footprints.
